title: FLARE - Financial Named Entity Recognition
description: Named entity recognition and document classification for financial texts, based on the FLARE benchmark introduced in PIXIU (Xie et al., NeurIPS 2023 Datasets & Benchmarks). Annotators identify financial entities such as companies, currencies, stock tickers, and amounts, and classify document types.
paperReference: Xie et al., PIXIU (NeurIPS 2023 Datasets & Benchmarks)
